title: Context Variance Evaluation of Pretrained Language Models for Prompt-based Biomedical Knowledge Probing

bias_targets.methodology: Mitigating and evaluating the bias caused by a model's linguistic preference for certain prompts by introducing context variance and calculating a statistical rank-change metric (Understand-Confuse-Misunderstand, or UCM) over a large number of context-augmented prompts.

Addressing the inconsistency of evaluations caused by different surface verbalizations of the same underlying concept by mapping texts to UMLS concepts and evaluating models using a diverse set of real-world context variations.

Controlling for evaluation differences that stem from disparities in models' pretraining corpora by testing models on multiple representative domain-specific datasets, including a completely unseen third corpus (LMC-EHRs) for fair comparison.
